paragraphs: Ahavah son of Rabbi Zeira: [Eruvin 96b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.96b.13-14); in the Jerusalem Talmud he is called Achavah, Acha or Achaya. Rav Zutra son of Rav Zeira: [Shabbat 157a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.157a.12).[^1]

notes.text: Eruvin calls Ahavah the son of Rabbi Zeira. Shabbat calls Rav Zutra the son of Rav Zeira. Hyman reports the Jerusalem Talmud spellings for Ahavah without giving a locator.
